title: [WT-10] Wrappers: quality gate on the merged tree under the land lease
description:
Plan against docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §2.2 (L3, L6, L14) and §2.3.

Objective: when settings.qualityGate applies, main is updated only after the gate passes on the exact merged tree that will land (epic rail 1). Seats of this project serialize through one daemon lease, so the gate rarely re-runs under contention.

Deliverable, in scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 as twins:
- L3, only when a gate will run: acquire_resource on `git-land-<target>` (every character outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] replaced by '-', at most 64 chars), then wait_for_resource until granted, bounded by MOE_LAND_LEASE_WAIT_SEC (default 1800). A timeout or RPC failure gives MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE and lands nothing (record failed; WT-11 adds the route with reason contention).
- L6: the existing freeze_candidate B M + run_frozen_gate (New-MoeFrozenCandidate / Invoke-MoeFrozenGate), fed the merged tree M with parent B. Failure gives the existing MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE and lands nothing (WT-11 adds the route with reason gate).
- Under the lease at most 2 L4-L10 attempts, each re-running the gate on the new merge.
- L14: release_resource on every path, including failures and the exit trap.
- Cases in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and postflight.ps1. Depends on WT-09 (task-0921d6d76a6b40a685077245b19ac639).

NOT in scope: declaring the resource in settings (the §7.3 runbook); the unlanded route (WT-11); shared-mode gate behaviour, which stays unchanged; docs (WT-17/WT-18).

Verification: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh (and on a Windows seat: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell)
definitionOfDone: postflight case (both harnesses): with a qualityGate, the gate's frozen commit has tree M (the merge of B and T) and parent B; a passing gate lands C, a failing gate prints MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE and leaves main unchanged.
postflight case: the fake proxy sees acquire_resource for git-land-main before the gate and release_resource after, on both the pass and the fail path; with no qualityGate no lease call is made.
postflight case: a lease wait past MOE_LAND_LEASE_WAIT_SEC prints MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE and lands nothing.
bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh still passes unchanged; existing shared-mode gate cases pass unchanged.
Both wrappers carry the same MOE_WORKTREE_/MOE_LAND_/MOE_CONTROL_/MOE_BOARD_ codes; the verification command exits 0 and postflight.ps1 passes on a Windows seat.
